ArmorSets.Name: Force Converter
ArmorSets.Description:
Upon scoring a Micro-Missile, Rocket Launcher or Grenade Launcher Kill:
Grants Force Converter.

Sprinting while Force Converter is active grants Speed Booster.

Missiles:
Quicksilver Storm's Rocket Tracer, Nanotech Tracer Rounds, Exhaustive Research Rockets, Rocket Frames, Grand Overture Missiles, and Hazardous Propulsion's Exodus Rockets.

ArmorSets.Name: Reactive Booster
ArmorSets.Description:
Sprinting while at Critical Health, being Suspended, or being affected by a Stasis Debuff will grant Speed Booster.
Can only trigger once per Force Converter activation.

ArmorSets.Name: Force Absorption
ArmorSets.Description:
Upon scoring a Missile, Rocket Launcher or Grenade Launcher Kill:
Grants 20% Area-of-Effect Damage Resist and 60% Explosive Self-Damage Resist for 15 seconds.

Missiles:
Quicksilver Storm's Rocket Tracer, Nanotech Tracer Round, Exhaustive Research Rockets, Rocket Frames, Grand Overture Missiles, and Hazardous Propulsion's Exodus Rockets.

ArmorSets.Name: Reactive Shock
ArmorSets.Description:
While Force Absorption is active:
Being hit by a Melee Attack triggers a Disorienting Burst, disorienting enemies within ? meters for ? seconds.
Can only trigger once per Reactive Shock activation.

ArmorSets.Name: Iaido
ArmorSets.Description:
Scoring a Weapon Kill within ? seconds of reloading or readying a gun restores 35 HP.
Incurs a ~3 second cooldown upon triggering. Must reload or swap weapons after the cooldown is over for the effect to trigger on kill.

ArmorSets.Name: Unfaltering Focus
ArmorSets.Description:
On Bow, Shotgun, or Sword Kill:
Grants Resist x1 (10% | 2.5%) for 7 seconds.
Dealing additional Weapon Damage extends the buff duration by +2 seconds, up to 9 seconds.

ArmorSets.Name: Accretion
ArmorSets.Description:
On Ammo Brick Pickup:
Grants stacks of Accretion, up to a maximum of 20 stacks. Stacks persist until death.
Special Ammo Bricks grant 1 stack of Accretion. Heavy Ammo Bricks grant 3 stacks of Accretion.

Accretion:
Grants a Ready/Stow Animation Duration Multiplier per stack, up to a maximum of 0.8x Ready/Stow Animation Duration at 20 stacks.

ArmorSets.Name: Doppler Effect
ArmorSets.Description:
Solar Buffs applied to the user and Strand Debuffs inflicted to enemies last 50% longer.
Equipping Ember of Solace or Thread of Continuity results in the effects lasting 70% longer.

ArmorSets.Name: Costumes
ArmorSets.Description: Has an Armor Mod Slot to convert the armor piece into another Armor Set's, counting as a piece for that set for both Armor Set Bonuses and New Gear Bonus.
ArmorSets.hash_warning: No matching hash found in d2glossary

ArmorSets.Name: Pleas Heard
ArmorSets.Description:
Upon finishing an Auto Rifle, Scout Rifle, or Sidearm reload within 3 seconds of a kill:
Restores 20HP/s until firing any weapon, casting Grenade, Melee, Class, or Super Ability, or upon taking damage from an enemy. 

Can be triggered multiple times from a single kill if another reload is performed within the time window.
Receiving Environmental Damage, or dealing damage through other means does not stop the health regen.

ArmorSets.Name: Magnificent Duty
ArmorSets.Description:
Upon reaching Critical Health or healing an ally at Critical Health:

For Auto Rifles, Scout Rifles, and Sidearms:
+20 Range, +20 Stability, +30 Reload Speed, and 0.9x Reload Duration Multiplier for 11 seconds.

Using a Support Frame Auto to heal a Critical Health Ally after triggering the Pleas Heard effect removes the healing effect as it requires firing to heal... Bungie?

ArmorSets.Name: Rapid Repair
ArmorSets.Description:
Upon healing Shield HP:
 10% [2.5%] Damage Resist (Resist x1) and ?% Flinch Resist for 7 seconds.

ArmorSets.Name: Hot Shot
ArmorSets.Description:
While Heavy? Ammo Reserves are <% Maximum Total Ammo:
Combatant Kills grant additional Ammo Progress based on their Ammo Type. Bonus Ammo Progress is unaffected by scalars.

Primary Ammo Weapons grant +3% Bonus Special Ammo Progress.
Special Ammo Weapons receive +2% Bonus Heavy Ammo Progress.

ArmorSets.Name: Vigilant Watch
ArmorSets.Description:
As Shield HP drops, initially triggering at ? Shield HP, maxing out in effect at ? Shield HP:
Linearly? grants up to +? Stability and +? Handling

While at Critical Health:
Weapon Kills restore 30HP.
Incurs a 5 second cooldown between triggers.

ArmorSets.Name: Iron Conviction
ArmorSets.Description:
Upon reaching Critical Health:

+35 Ammo Generation Stat, ?% Flinch Resist, and 15% Damage Resist against Combatants within 15? meters for 7 seconds.
Additional kills while the buff is active refreshes the buff duration.

Buff cannot retrigger from reaching Critical Health for ? seconds upon triggering.

ArmorSets.Name: Terminal Velocity
ArmorSets.Description:
Upon scoring a Primary Weapon Kill:
+20 Reload Speed and 0.95x Reload Duration Multiplier for Primary Weapons for 6 seconds.
Also triggers from destroying Constructs.

ArmorSets.Name: Power Loader
ArmorSets.Description:
Upon picking up an Orb of Power:
Grants 6% Special Ammo Progress.

ArmorSets.Name: Photogalvanic
ArmorSets.Description:
Upon receiving ANY healing while not at Full HP:
+20? Handling, +10 Reload Speed, 0.85x Reload Duration Multiplier, and ?% Flinch Resist for Solar Weapons for 4 seconds.
Works with ANY source of healing, such as Orb Pickups. Restoration constantly refreshes it

ArmorSets.Name: Cauterize
ArmorSets.Description:
Upon scoring 3 Solar Kills within 3? seconds of each:
Restores 35 HP.

ArmorSets.Name: Paroli
ArmorSets.Description:
Upon sliding:
?% Flinch Resist for ? seconds.

ArmorSets.Name: Martingale
ArmorSets.Description:
On Ally Death or Ally Revival:
+? Handling and 0.?x ADS Duration Multiplier for 10 seconds.

ArmorSets.Name: Combat Meditation
ArmorSets.Description:
On Sword Hit:
Grants 3% Grenade and Class Ability Energy. 
Increased to 8% Grenade and Class Ability Energy while Blade Focus is active.

ArmorSets.Name: Blade Focus
ArmorSets.Description:
Upon guarding for 1.35 seconds:
Grants Blade Focus Ready for 1 second.
 Swinging while it is active AND scoring a hit consumes Blade Focus Ready to grant Blade Focus.

Blade Focus grants 10% Increased Sword Damage, 100% Increased Sword Lunge Distance, and doubled Combat Meditation Energy Gains for 7 seconds.
Blade Focus is removed upon guarding or stowing the sword.

ArmorSets.Name: Reflex Action
ArmorSets.Description:
Upon readying a Heat Weapon, Submachine Gun, or Hand Cannon:
Grants Reflex Action for 1.5 seconds.
 Dealing Additional Weapon Damage refreshes the buff duration.

Reflex Action | +50? Handling, 0.6?x Ready Duration Multiplier, and -2.5% Accuracy Cone Size for 1.5 seconds.

ArmorSets.Name: Hot Shot
ArmorSets.Description:
While Reflex Action is active:
Scoring a kill grants Hotshot for 10 seconds.
Buff can be refreshed by retriggering Hotshot.

Hotshot? | +15? Stability, +20 Reload Speed, and +? Aim Assist for Heat Weapons, Submachine Guns, and Hand Cannons. Additionally, it grants +30 Weapons stat.

ArmorSets.Name: Ride Together, Die Together
ArmorSets.Description:
On Orb of Power Pickup:
Grants Ride Together, Die Together for 3 seconds.
Ride Together, Die Together initially grants 50% [5%] Damage Resist.
Damage Resist scales down to ~37.5% with 1.5 seconds left, further reduced to 30% with 1 second left, decreasing down to 0% over the remaining second.

ArmorSets.Name: Too Old for This
ArmorSets.Description:
Upon finishing an Elite+ Combatant:
Grants 16% Special Ammo Progress and restores 35 HP.

ArmorSets.Name: Balestra
ArmorSets.Description:
Upon damaging an enemy with a Sword, Glaive, or Melee Attack:
Inflicts Exhaustion for ? seconds.

ArmorSets.Name: Stesso Tempo
ArmorSets.Description:
Upon blocking damage with a Glaive or a Sword:
50% [10%] Damage Resist (Resist x4) for 3 seconds upon no longer guarding. 
Damage Resist can be reset by blocking and dropping the guard before buff expires.

ArmorSets.Name: Wrecker
ArmorSets.Description:
Passively grants increased Kinetic Damage towards Combatant Shields, Overshields, Vehicles, and Constructs.
200% increased Kinetic Damage towards Combatant Shields and Combatant Overshields. Damage shows up as Yellow Numbers.
15% increased Kinetic Damage towards Constructs. Koregos is not a Construct lol
It's ALL Kinetic Damage, including Poison, Praxic Blade, and Unpowered/Glaive Melee!

ArmorSets.Name: Concussive Rounds
ArmorSets.Description:
Upon killing an Elite+ Combatant, or breaking a Combatant Shield with Kinetic Damage:
Triggers a disorienting Kinetic blast, dealing up to 162 Kinetic Damage, heavily staggering, and inflicting disorient to enemies within 10 meters for ? seconds.

ArmorSets.Name: Opening Act
ArmorSets.Description:
Upon scoring a Grenade Kill:
Grants Opening Act for 15 seconds.

Opening Act | +? Stability and +? Vent Speed to Heat Weapons. Primary Weapons are instead granted +? Stability and +? Reload Speed.

ArmorSets.Name: Room Clearing
ArmorSets.Description:
Upon scoring 3 Heat Weapons or Primary Weapon Kills within 4 seconds of each:
Grants Room Cleaning for 10 seconds.

Room Cleaning | +40 Grenade and +40 Weapon. Additionally, it grants +40 Ammo Generation for Heat Weapons and Primary Ammo Weapons.

ArmorSets.Name: Crook and Flail
ArmorSets.Description:
On Ammo Brick Pickup:
Restores 70 HP.

ArmorSets.Name: Gift of Sight
ArmorSets.Description:
Upon scoring a Primary Weapon Kill:
Grants Enhanced Radar for 5 seconds.
Also triggers from destroying Constructs.

ArmorSets.Name: Special Relativity
ArmorSets.Description:
On Ammo Brick Pickup:
Refills stowed Special Weapons.

ArmorSets.Name: Superluminal Motion
ArmorSets.Description:
Upon dealing Super Damage:, while Movement Speed isn't 0m/s:
Restores 15HP/s for 11 seconds. 
Dealing Additional Super Damage refreshes the buff duration.

ArmorSets.Name: Fanfare
ArmorSets.Description:
While Ammo = ≤50% of Magazine AND Ammo ≠ 0:
+15 Reload Speed and 0.95x Reload Duration Multiplier.

Does not trigger at 0 Ammo. rip bows and GLs

ArmorSets.Name: Suros Harmony
ArmorSets.Description:
Upon finishing a reload:
SUROS Harmony | +? Handling and ?% Flinch Resist for 6 seconds.
Weapons that have the SUROS Synergy Origin Trait equipped, as well as SUROS Regime are additionally granted +15 Range. 
For some reason, the +Range benefit's timer begins only once you are able to shoot in the reload animation instead of when the ammo is refilled.

SUROS Harmony persists through stow, but only on the weapon that it was triggered on. 
Can be refreshed by retriggering the buff unless it is a SUROS Weapon lmao.

ArcVerbs.Name: Amplified
ArcVerbs.Description:
Intrinsic Arc Subclass Buff
Obtained by reaching 100% Counter Progress through Arc Kills within 6 seconds of each, or through Aspects.
Rank-And-File = 25% | Elite = 50% | Miniboss+ = 100% | Guardians = 50%

Amplified:
+50 Mobility, 33% Increased Slide Distance, +40 Handling, and 0.95x Handling Duration Multiplier for 15 seconds. 
Combatants are less accurate at targeting the wearer and grants 15% Damage Resist against Combatants while Amplified.
While Amplified, sprinting for 2.5 seconds grants Speed Booster.

Speed Booster:
Maximized Movement Speed, 50% Increased Slide Distance, 25% Increased Jump Height, and 15% Damage Resist against Combatants.
Speed Booster lingers for 2 seconds until no longer sprinting, even after Amplified runs out.

Being Amplified enhances certain Abilities.

ArcVerbs.Name: Bolt Charge
ArcVerbs.Description:
Damage instances scored within 3 seconds of each while Bolt Charge is active increments a Magazine-capacity based counter towards gaining a stack of Bolt Charge.
Grants 2.5% Melee Ability Energy per Bolt Charge stack obtained, up to 25% Melee Ability Energy over the 10 stacks needed to discharge.
Swapping weapons resets the counter. Gaining a stack through damage prevents simultaneous damage instances from incrementing the counter.
Acquiring over x10 stacks through abilities will still grant the corresponding Ability Gains (For example, being at x9 and acquiring x4 will still grant 10% Melee Energy)

Damage instances needed to gain a stack:
(15% of Magazine, rounded down) + 2
Area-Denial GLs: 3 or 4?
Swords: 2
3-Ammo Snipers: 1
Glaive Melee, as well as Damage-over-Time sources all count.

After 0.5 seconds of scoring an Ability Hit or dealing Unpowered Melee Damage while at x10 Bolt Charge stacks:
Discharges an Arc Bolt over the damaged enemy, dealing up to 405 Bolt Splash + 270 Floor Splash = 675 Total [36 Bolt Splash + 30 Floor Splash] Arc Damage over ? meters.

Triggers Discharge:
Volatile Explosions | Freeze Shatter (Not auto-shatter on Bosses) | Tangle Explosions | Threadlings | Unraveling Threads | Suspend Snap on Bosses | Forerunner's The Rock

Do NOT trigger Discharge:
 Jolt's Chain Lightning | Scorch and Ignitions (from Non-Abilities) | Crystal Shatter (from Non-Abilities) | Glaive Melee | Gifted Conviction's Explosives

ArcVerbs.Name: Ionic Traces
ArcVerbs.Description:
Arc Elemental Pickup.

Energizing Seekers that home in towards the user at a speed of 6m/s, granting 15% Grenade, Melee, Class Ability Energy on pickup. Allies do not receive Ionic Traces created by the user.
ArcVerbs.hash_warning: No matching hash found in d2glossary

ArcVerbs.Name: Blind
ArcVerbs.Description:
Blinded Combatants are disoriented, rendering them unable to attack or use abilities for 10 seconds.

Blinded Guardians have their HUD removed, screen whitened, and audio distorted for 3 seconds.

Unstoppable Champions become Stunned upon being Blinded.

ArcVerbs.Name: Jolt
ArcVerbs.Description:
Jolted Enemies will release chain lightning for 10 [5] seconds, dealing 119 [51] Arc Damage to all enemies within 12 meters upon taking 115 [45] damage. 
Duration can be refreshed by reinflicting Jolt.
 The damage from the hit that applies Jolt counts towards the damage threshold. Jolt has a 0.8 second cooldown between chain lightning activations.

Guardians that release Chain Lightning do not receive chain damage unless it deals damage to other Guardians.

Overload Champions become Stunned upon receiving Jolt damage.
ArcVerbs.hash_warning: No matching hash found in d2glossary

SolarVerbs.Name: Cure
SolarVerbs.Description:
Restores 60 [30] HP per stack of Cure over 0.1 seconds.

Incurs a 1 second cooldown between Cure activations. Additional activations will not recover health.

SolarVerbs.Name: Firesprite
SolarVerbs.Description:
Solar Elemental Pickup.

Grants 12.5% Grenade Ability Energy on Pickup. Allies do not receive Firesprites created by the user.
Lasts 25 seconds before disappearing. Incurs a 5 second cooldown between Firesprite spawns.

SolarVerbs.Name: Radiant
SolarVerbs.Description:
Increases Weapon Damage by 20% [10%] for 10 seconds and can be extended up to 15 seconds by default. 
Also affects Golden Gun's Damage.

Reapplying Radiant will refresh its duration to its longest achieved duration.

Barrier Champion Shields are damageable while Radiant, stunning the Champion once destroyed.

SolarVerbs.Name: Restoration
SolarVerbs.Description:
Continuously restores health. Effect is uninterruptible and can be extended up to 15 seconds by default. 
x1 = 35 [17.5] HP/s | x2 = 50 [25] HP/s
Healing Effect does not stack with Healing Rift.

Reapplying Restoration will refresh its duration to its longest achieved duration, keeping the highest Restoration stack.
If the new duration is longer than the previous longest, the new duration is used instead.
Eg: If the maximum Restoration duration achieved was 15 seconds, a Phoenix Dive or Healing Grenade will refresh it to 15 seconds.
Using a Phoenix Dive after using a Healing Grenade will refresh its duration to 4+2 seconds.
Empyrean and Mercy are both duration extenders, and do not count as reapplying Restoration. Extending a Solar Effect that is at >15 seconds will set it to 15 seconds.

SolarVerbs.Name: Ignition
SolarVerbs.Description:
Explosion that deals 676 [120 Guardians | 250 Construct] Solar Damage in a 8 meter radius without [with] damage falloff. 
Ignitions remove all Scorch, and incur a 1.6 second cooldown before Scorch can be reapplied. 

Ignition damage can be increased through certain damage increases if the initial Scorch source had a damage increase.
Eg: Verity's Brow x5 + Fusion Grenade = 100% Increased Ignition Damage.
Melee Damage Buffs do not scale Ignition nor Scorch damage.

Unstoppable Champions become Stunned upon receiving Ignition damage.

SolarVerbs.Name: Scorch
SolarVerbs.Description:
Scorched Enemies take a varying amount of damage every 0.56 seconds after being scorched for 1.4 seconds.
Ignition occurs upon reaching x100 Scorch stacks.

Scorch Damage per Tick:
2.7 + (0.175 * Scorch Stacks) | Non-Boss Combatants receive 20% increased damage.
 x1 = 3 | x30 = 5 | x50 = 6.5 | x60 = 7.21 | x80 = 8.64 | Scorch cannot kill.
Deals 2.5% increased damage after x60 Scorch, indicated by Yellow Damage Numbers.

Scorch Decay:
Scorch lasts for 4.5 seconds, then decreases by x5.67 stacks every 0.56 seconds. (~-10/s)
 Scorch lasts for 2.3 seconds, then decreases by x1 stacks every 0.04 seconds (-25/s)
The 1.4 second delay before damage occurs also counts towards the duration.

SolarVerbs.Name:
Solar Effect
Damage Scaling
SolarVerbs.Description:
Solar Effect (Scorch | Ignition) damage can be increased through Perks and Exotics, but the source used for initially scorching will determine what it will be counted as.
 
Applying a Solar Effect with a Weapon, such as with Incandescent or through Exotic Weapons such as Tommy's Matchbook or Conditional Finality, will result in Solar Effects counting as Weapon Damage, benefitting from Weapon Buffs and Activity Modifiers that exclusively benefit Weapons, such as Radiant, Solar Weapon Surges, and Overcharge.

Applying Solar Effects through abilities such as Fusion Grenades and Well of Radiance will result in the Solar Effects counting as Solar Ability Damage, with their damage only being increased by Grenade (Verity's Brow), and Super (Heart of the Flame) Damage Increases respectively. Melee Damage Buffs do not increase Solar Effect Damage.
Effects that increase all Ability Damage will benefit all Solar Effects that are initially applied through Solar Abilities.

Activity Modifiers that increase all Solar Damage, such as Solar Surge, will also apply to Solar Effects, regardless of source.

VoidVerbs.Name: Devour
VoidVerbs.Description:
Restores 70 HP on activation and grants Devour for 10+5 seconds. Reactivating Devour restores 70 HP and refreshes 5+3 seconds.
Scoring a kill while Devour is active restores 70 HP, grants Grenade Ability Energy, and refreshes 5+3 seconds of its duration.

Grenade Ability Energy on Kill:
Tier 1 Combatant = 7.5% | T2 = 11.6% | T3 = 13.75% | T4 = 20% | Guardians = 20%

VoidVerbs.Name: Invisibility
VoidVerbs.Description:
Cloaks the user, granting various benefits, while lowering Maximum Radar Range to 24 meters for 5+2 seconds. Immediately ends upon performing an Offensive Action.
 Radar Booster Weapon Mod removes the Radar Reduction. Reapplying Invisibility without it breaking refreshes the duration of the longest lasting invisibility.

Combatants are unable to directly target the user, preferring to either shoot at the user's last visible location, or not firing. Combatants will track through Loud Actions, but not fire.

Guardians are unable to see the user's health bar, and the user's radar will only ping every 5 seconds for 0.6 seconds, or upon performing Loud Actions.

Weapons and Abilities that are able to home in (Tracking Projectiles) or scan (Firebolt Grenades) for enemies will not target the user, and will stop tracking if they already were. 

Offensive Actions: Instantly ends Invisibility
Shooting | Grenade, Melee, Super, or Blink Ability Usage | Barricade or Rift Placement | Vehicle Summon

Loud Actions: Pings Radar | Combatants Track
Beginning Sprint | Non-Blink Movement Ability Usage | Hunter Class Ability Usage

VoidVerbs.Name: Overshield
VoidVerbs.Description:
Void Overshield with up to 45 HP for 10+5 seconds. Overshield has 70% Damage Resist against Combatants.

Damage dealt to Void Overshields does not stop Health Regeneration.
This applies to any Overshield.

Cannot gain Overshield while in a Healing Rift.

VoidVerbs.Name: Void Breach
VoidVerbs.Description:
Void Elemental Pickup.

Grants 12.5% Class Ability Energy on Pickup. Allies do not receive Void Breaches created by the user.
Lasts 25 seconds before disappearing. Incurs a 5 second cooldown between Void Breach spawns.

VoidVerbs.Name: Suppression
VoidVerbs.Description:
Suppressed Enemies are removed from active abilities and are unable to use abilities for 10 [5] seconds.

Suppressed Rank-and-File and Elite Combatants also become disoriented and will be unable to shoot.

Suppressed Guardians are removed from their active Super Ability and Transcendence, and cannot use Grenade, Melee, Class, Super, Movement Abilities, and Transcendence.

Overload Champions become Stunned upon being Suppressed.

VoidVerbs.Name: Volatile
VoidVerbs.Description:
Volatile Enemies trigger an explosion after receiving 190 [200] damage, or upon dying, dealing up to 145 [80] Void Damage in a 5 meter radius.
Volatile lasts for 10 [6] seconds, harmlessly expiring afterwards. Debuff is removed after triggering the explosion.
The damage from the hit that applies Volatile doesn't count towards the detonation threshold. 
Incurs a 1 second cooldown before Volatile can be reapplied to an enemy after the explosion is triggered.

VoidVerbs.Name: Volatile Rounds
VoidVerbs.Description: Void Weapons inflict Volatile upon dealing damage, and Barrier Champion Shields are able to be damaged, stunning the Champion when destroyed while Volatile Rounds are active.
VoidVerbs.hash_warning: No matching hash found in d2glossary

VoidVerbs.Name: Weaken
VoidVerbs.Description:
Weakened Enemies receive 15% [7.5%] increased damage and 20% Decreased Movement Speed for 6 [2.5] seconds.

Weakened Combatants become less accurate.

Unique Weaken Effects:
Certain sources of Weaken inflict a stronger Weaken that grants 30% [varies%] increased damage.

Shadowshot grants 30% [50%] increased damage against tethered enemies with both Deadfall and Moebius variations.
Felwinter's Helm's Warlord's End grants 30% [30%] increased damage against enemies affected by its weakening burst. Its duration can be extended by any other Weaken effect.
Tractor Cannon's Repulsor Force grants 30% [50%] increased damage against enemies it damages. Its duration can be extended by any other Weaken effect.

StasisVerbs.Name: Stasis Shard
StasisVerbs.Description:
Stasis Elemental Pickup.

Stasis Shards grant Melee Ability Energy on pickup. 
Shards last for 20 seconds. Allies receive a copy of all Shards created by the user.
Small Stasis Shards grant 10% Melee Energy, and Large Stasis Shards grant 50% Melee Energy.

While Glacial, Grim or Tectonic Harvest is equipped:
Small Stasis Shards restore 10 HP and grant x1 Frost Armor.
Large Stasis Shards restore 20 HP and x3 Frost Armor.

StasisVerbs.Name: Stasis Crystal
StasisVerbs.Description:
Solid Pillars that can be spawned on surfaces, possessing a varying amounts of health depending on their size, lasting up to 15 seconds.

Crystals, upon being created, apply freeze [x15 Slow Stacks for 1.5+0.5 seconds] to enemies within 2.6 metres. 

Stasis Crystals can be destroyed by depleting their health, dealing up to 175 [25] damage in a 8 metre radius.

Small Crystals: ? HP | Medium Crystal: ? HP | Large Crystal: ? HP
User deals double damage to their own Crystals.

StasisVerbs.Name: Frost Armor
StasisVerbs.Description:
Grants 6.25% [2%] Damage Resist per stack, up to 31.25% [10%] Damage Resist at x5 stacks for 9 seconds.
Damage Resist per stack is decreased to ?% [?%] while in Super.

Whisper of Rime:
Increases the maximum stack amount to x8, increasing the maximum Damage Resist to 50% [16%]
Increases the maximum duration to 13 seconds.

StasisVerbs.Name: Slow
StasisVerbs.Description:
Slowed Enemies receive multiple penalties related to movement or weapon performance.
Freeze occurs upon reaching x100 Slow.

Slowed Combatants have 50% Decreased Movement Speed and are less accurate.

Slowed Guardians have 50% Reduced Movement Speed, 50% Decreased Jump Height, are unable to use Movement Abilities, receive ?% increased Flinch, and have a penalty to their Weapon Stats.

Slowed Weapon Stat Penalties:
Stability, Handling, Reload Speed and Recoil Direction are decreased by 75%.
Stat Reduction takes place after Weapon Perks. Weapon Stats are considered uncapped before slow's reduction is applied.
Eg: 160 Reload Speed will be reduced be 40 Reload Speed. 80 Handling would be reduced to 20 Handling.

Overload Champions become Stunned upon receiving any amount of Slow Stacks.

StasisVerbs.Name: Freeze
StasisVerbs.Description:
Frozen Enemies are completely immobilized, rendering them unable to shoot, use abilities, or move.
Frozen Enemies receive 10% increased damage from Special and Power Weapons, 5% increased damage from Arc, Solar, and Void Abilities, and 5% [60%] decreased damage from Primary Weapons. 
Frozen Rank-and-File and Elite Combatants, as well as Guardians receive 120% increased Basic Melee and Glaive Melee Attack Damage.

Frozen Enemies shatter after receiving varying [200] damage.

Frozen Enemies are immobilized for 6 [1.35 to 4.75] seconds. 
Boss Combatants are unhindered by freeze and automatically shatter after 3 seconds.
Grounded Guardians can cast their Super Ability to instantly break out.

Brief Freeze:
Guardians frozen by other Guardians are frozen for 1.35 seconds

Prolonged Freeze:
Guardians that become frozen by Combatants, or by Stasis Super Abilities, are frozen for 4.75 seconds.
Frozen Guardians have their Class Ability replaced with Breakout, which allows breaking out of the long-lasting freeze, in exchange for ? Health.
Guardians that are frozen during a Roaming Super automatically break out after a second, while One-off Supers get deactivated if frozen during the cast animation.

StasisVerbs.Name: Shatter
StasisVerbs.Description:
Frozen Enemies can be shattered through damage or directly through specific Stasis Aspects, dealing up to 400 [?] damage to enemies within ? metres.

Overload Champions become Stunned upon receiving shatter damage.

StrandVerbs.Name: Tangle
StrandVerbs.Description:
Strand Elemental Pickup

 Spawned when an enemy affected by a Strand Debuff (Sever, Suspend, Unravel) is killed while on a Strand Subclass, or through Exotic Gear. 
Lasts up to 20 seconds on the ground. Lasts up to 20 seconds when held. Incurs a 12 second cooldown upon creating a Tangle.

Detonating a Tangle through damaging it or throwing it creates an explosion, dealing up to 346 [100] damage in a 5? metre radius.

Grappling a Tangle fully refunds Grenade Energy and pulls the user towards it.

StrandVerbs.Name: Grapple Tangle
StrandVerbs.Description:
Tangle Equivalent that exclusively interacts with Grapple, behaving identically to a Tangle for Grappling.

Lasts for up to 20 seconds. Duration is refreshed by 5 seconds upon using Grapple on it. Cannot be destroyed, nor picked up.
Targeting a Grapple Tangle within 27 meters (32m with Grapple Grenade equipped) for 0.3 seconds overrides Grenade Ability to a Non-Offensive Grapple.

Grappling a Grapple Tangle 5 consecutive times reduces the duration refresh to 1 second.
StrandVerbs.hash_warning: No matching hash found in d2glossary

StrandVerbs.Name: Threadling
StrandVerbs.Description:
Strand minions that chase enemies within 20? metres, leaping towards the targeted enemy upon being within ? metres.

Threadlings explode on contact or after leaping, dealing up to 338 [35] damage in a small radius.
Threadlings that lose their target before impact will land and look for another combatant instead of exploding.
Threadlings count as damage from the source they were spawned, but will lose that inheritance if they perch.

Warlock Interaction:
Threadlings return after travelling 14 metres if they do not start chasing an enemy, remaining perched on the Warlock, up to a maximum of 5 Threadlings. 
Threadlings are individually released upon dealing weapon damage or scoring a Melee Hit, with a 0.5 second cooldown between releases. 
Threadlings released this way will track at any range.

StrandVerbs.Name: Woven Mail
StrandVerbs.Description:
Grants 45% [25%] Damage Resist for 10 seconds. 
Precision Hits and Melee Attacks from Guardians bypass the Damage Resist.

StrandVerbs.Name: Sever
StrandVerbs.Description: Decreases the enemy's outgoing damage dealt by 40% [15%] for 10+5 [5+2.5] seconds.

StrandVerbs.Name: Suspend
StrandVerbs.Description:
Suspended Enemies are held midair, unable to use abilities.

Suspended Combatants are unable to move, shoot, or use abilities.
Rank-and-File and Elite Combatants are suspended for up to 6+2 seconds. Minibosses are only suspended for up to 3+1 seconds.
Boss Combatants are immune to suspension, instead receiving 300 damage after ? seconds.

Suspended Guardians are lifted midair, being able to slowly hover and hipfire their weapons for 2+1 seconds in a third-person perspective.

Suspending Blasts deal up to 120 [40] damage and inflict Suspend to enemies within 10 meters.

Unstoppable Champions are stunned upon being Suspended.

StrandVerbs.Name: Unravel
StrandVerbs.Description:
Unraveled Enemies release 3 seeking threads towards enemies within ? metres 0.25 seconds after receiving 40 damage.
Each Thread deals 26 [4] damage and applies Unravel on hit.
Unravel has a 1.2 second cooldown between thread releases. 

 Thread hits refresh the duration of Unravel, up to its original duration. 
(If the Unravel source applied a 9 second debuff, thread hits will reapply it to 9 seconds)

StrandVerbs.Name: Unraveling Rounds
StrandVerbs.Description: Strand Weapons apply Unravel upon dealing damage, and Barrier Champion Shields are able to be damaged while Unraveling Rounds are active, stunning the Champion when destroyed.

PrismaticVerbs.Name: Transcendence
PrismaticVerbs.Description:
Unique ability obtained upon utilizing enough Light and Darkness damage types.
Kinetic Damage fills both Light and Darkness bars at 50% decreased rate. Overkill Damage isn't counted for Transcendence gains.

Dealing damage, alongside applying Elemental Effects grants Transcendence Energy. 
Applying Elemental Effects, both buffs and debuffs, grant Transcendence Energy to their corresponding alignment.

Transcendence:
Instantly recharges 2 Grenade and Melee Ability Charges on activation.
Replaces Grenade Ability with an unique class-specific Prismatic Grenade Ability with Light and Darkness damage types.
Grants 5% Increased Weapon Damage, an additional 10% Grenade and Melee Regeneration Speed, and 20% [5%] Damage Resist for 20 seconds.
Damage Increase stacks with everything.

Dealing Grenade Ability Damage while Transcendent increases the Melee Regeneration Speed to 35% Fixed Melee Ability Energy per second for 2 seconds.
Dealing Melee Ability Damage while Transcendent increases the Prismatic Grenade Regeneration Speed to 35% Prismatic Grenade Ability Energy per second for 2 seconds.

Kills while Transcendent extend its duration, with the amount extended decreasing as more kills are scored.
Tier 1 and T2 Combatants = 5% | T3 and T4 = 10% | T3 Elites, Minibosses and Bosses = 15% | Guardians = ?%
Each kill after the first gets a cumulative 0.9?x penalty to the duration extension.
